description: This source file implements a QUIC client interop testing tool that performs various protocol feature tests such as version negotiation, handshake, stream data exchange, connection close, TLS resumption, 0-RTT, retries, HTTP/3, key updates, and server rebinding. It constructs and sends HTTP/2 requests over QUIC, manages connection features, and outputs a feature matrix indicating server support for different protocol features.

classes.name: QuicClientInteropRunner
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of QUIC protocol feature tests, tracks supported features, and handles protocol interactions such as version negotiation, handshakes, data exchange, and connection management.

methods.name: AttemptResumption
methods.description: Attempts a session resumption by disconnecting and reconnecting the client, and updates features if successful.

methods.name: AttemptRequest
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive protocol feature test by establishing a connection, negotiating versions, performing handshakes, sending HTTP requests, testing rebinds and key updates, and closing the connection while recording supported features.

methods.name: ConstructHeaderBlock
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP/2 header block for a GET request to the specified authority.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using the client and records features like stream data exchange.
